title: rule.rejected
description: An analyst rejected a rule candidate the pipeline extracted: before drafting it, or after drafting it into a rule version that their review then refused. No rule changes: the candidate is closed with the reason, and a draft made from it stays a draft. Producer: rulebook (the decision on a candidate's review task, in the same transaction). Consumers: none yet; the pipeline's operations and the golden export read rejections later.
x-producer: rulebook (the decision on a candidate's review task)

candidate_id.description: The rejected candidate, as rule.candidate.created named it.

document_id.description: The document it was extracted from.

regulator.description: The regulator of the candidate's review queue, in lower case.

reason.description: Why: not_a_rule, the document states no rule; wrong_extraction, the model read it wrongly; duplicate, another candidate or rule already holds it; out_of_scope, a rule the product does not cover; unparseable, the extraction gave no candidate to draft from.

prompt_version.description: The prompt the candidate was extracted with, as name@version.

model.description: The model that produced the candidate.

rule_version_id.description: The draft the candidate became, when it was drafted before the rejection; null when it was rejected before drafting.
